sprint: World-Owned Text Style — Delete Joins the Popup; Story-Owned Freeform Text Gets Its Own Quick-Edit From the Second Selection Onward
task: '2 corrections for text object. 1st. under modify delete is also an option. add that. 2nd for a studio owned text show the same options in right panel for first time edition from next time onwards its context menu.' Both corrections scoped precisely to a Story-owned freeform Text sticker -- never World-owned text, which stays permanently un-deletable and untouched. (1) ContextPanel.mountQuickEditControl widened from a single World-owned branch into a real dispatch: a Story-owned text sticker now routes to a new _appendStickerTextEditControl mirroring CardDesigner's own sticker Text group field-for-field (Words/Font/Weight/Style/Alignment/Size/Width/Colour/Opacity/Spin), ending in a real 'Delete' button that removes the sticker and clears selection. The shared commit tail is renamed _afterWorldObjectEdit -> _afterQuickEditChange to reflect its now-wider job. (2) A new persistent per-sticker _edited flag, computed exactly once per genuine NEW selection (never on a same-selection refresh, so the very first editing session is never yanked away mid-keystroke), makes the SECOND-and-later selection of the same text object show a lightweight quick-edit pointer view (pointing at the Selection Action Strip's own Edit button, with an 'Open Full Editor' escape hatch) instead of reopening the full right-panel editor every time -- the first selection ever is completely unaffected. Verified via two new Playwright suites (sticker_text_quickedit_verify.js 32/32, world_owned_delete_absent_verify.js 7/7 confirming World-owned objects are untouched) plus two pre-existing regression scripts (bold_toggle_verify.js 22/22, welcome_heading_removed_verify.js 4/4) -- 65 total assertions, zero failures, zero console/page errors. Both goldenBuild.js suites (World Builder v1 and v2) pass unchanged -- confined entirely to root Studio. No Theme Contract/Engine V2 Scene Model/Builder architecture change; confined to js/contextPanel.js and css/style.css.
